description: Writer 6 activation release after reader 6 compatibility has been deployed. Enables new bounded commerce and PayPal checkout orders only when live PayPal merchant credentials, verified receiving identity, signed webhook configuration and PAYPAL_ENABLED=on pass the runtime fail-closed checks. Existing signed receipts, Durable Object state, x402 payment contracts and recovery records remain compatible. Never downgrade to a pre-reader-6 release after new payments; do not claim payment activation or customer revenue until a confirmed live transaction and delivery canary.
